lean.fidelity_note: The paper fixes the zero-mean Poisson pressure and normalizes $\max_{[t_0,T]}|\mathbf a(t,0)|=\lambda^{-3/4}$. The formal statement allows any smooth periodic parent pressure satisfying the stated residual and coercivity conditions, and requires only $0<|\mathbf a(t,0)|\le\lambda^{-3/4}$. The weighted bounds on $[t_0,T]$, unweighted bounds on $[0,T]$, and both improvements for phase-independent fields are retained. The formal statement also allows any real normed target space and explicitly concludes Hölder regularity. Its derivative sum counts all ordered coordinate derivative sequences; smoothness identifies repeated mixed derivatives, and their order-dependent multiplicities are absorbed into $C_m$. The profiles already include the smooth continuation across cell faces described in the paper. Once the envelope exponent is fixed, the constants are chosen uniformly before the parent and target space, and the parent exponent does not depend on derivative order or depth. Phase-independent fields incur no factor $\lambda^{3/2}$ per derivative.
lean.name: TorusEuler.Paper.lemma_5_7
